# freshdesk_tickets (Data Source)

Every ticket the API returns.

~> Freshdesk only lists tickets updated in the last 30 days, and this walks every page of that collection. Prefer a narrower lookup where you can.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_tickets" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `tickets`.
- `tickets` (Attributes List) Every ticket the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tickets))

<a id="nestedatt--tickets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tickets`

Read-Only:

- `cc_emails` (Set of String) Addresses copied on the correspondence.
- `company_id` (Number) ID of the company the ticket belongs to.
- `created_at` (String) When the ticket was created (RFC 3339).
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values keyed by field name.
- `description` (String) Opening message, in HTML.
- `description_text` (String) Plain-text rendering of the opening message.
- `due_by` (String) When the ticket must be resolved (RFC 3339).
- `email_config_id` (Number) ID of the email config the ticket came through.
- `fr_due_by` (String) When the first response is due (RFC 3339).
- `group_id` (Number) ID of the group the ticket is assigned to.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the ticket.
- `is_escalated` (Boolean) Whether the resolution SLA has been breached.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent ticket, for a child ticket.
- `priority` (Number) Priority: 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high, 4 urgent.
- `product_id` (Number) ID of the product the ticket concerns.
- `requester_id` (Number) ID of the contact who raised the ticket.
- `responder_id` (Number) ID of the agent the ticket is assigned to.
- `source` (Number) Channel the ticket arrived on.
- `spam` (Boolean) Whether the ticket is marked as spam.
- `status` (Number) Status: 2 open, 3 pending, 4 resolved, 5 closed.
- `subject` (String) Subject line of the ticket.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags applied to the ticket.
- `type` (String) Ticket type.
- `updated_at` (String) When the ticket was last changed (RFC 3339).
